note: Petersburg city's own parcel layer (petersburg_city_va_parcels FeatureServer, ArcGIS Online) refuses all requests with 'Token Required'; the city's Parcel Viewer (GeoDecisions logon, CivQuest Atlas) is login-gated and states its GIS data is proprietary. The statewide VGIN VA_Parcels/FeatureServer/0 layer is public and returns 556 polygons for Petersburg City (FIPS 51730), but PARCELID and PTM_ID are empty for every sampled parcel, so no apn, address or owner can be mapped.
